card.name: Words just before product numbers
card.fires_on: Words or marks right before a catalog, part, item, NDC or ISBN number, such as Part, Item, version, NDC and the hyphen inside an NDC code. Also a few other spots that introduce an identifier or bracketed cross-reference.

modes.label: Inside NDC codes
